id: RR-Y3-001 part 3 -- FMP free-tier scope: is 402 about the ENDPOINT or the SYMBOL?
why_it_matters: if the endpoint is paid, the free tier is useless for any backtest. If only DELISTED symbols are paid, the free tier serves the survivors and hides the casualties -- which is survivorship bias sold as a free tier. Opposite consequences; measured, not guessed.
